subject: Securing time for on-prem architecture review and next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@mediscape.com>, Brian O'Connor <brian.oconnor@mediscape.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Securing time for on-prem architecture review and next steps

Hi Alice / Brian —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the on-prem/VPC architecture review: 

Key takeaways from call:
- Primary goal: validate network topology and data flows for Mediscape's on-prem model serving (PHI boundaries + audit log retention).
- Expected scale: intermittent batch ingest, steady low-latency inference for clinician UI (~200 RPS peak across a few services).
- Compliance/controls: SOC 2 + regional data residency (US) required; you flagged an internal procurement review timeline (late Aug).

Next steps I propose:
1) 60-minute architecture review (technical deep-dive) with your infra and security teams — we will cover network, IAM, KMS integration, and runbook for incidents.
2) Exchange SOC/compliance artifacts and a short access matrix ahead of the call.
3) We will bring a short private-deploy checklist and sample on-prem runbook.

Availability (Pacific time) — can you confirm the best slot?
- Tue Jul 27, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Wed Jul 28, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu Jul 29, 08:00–09:00 PT

If none of those work, suggest two times and we’ll follow up. I’ve looped Marissa (solutions) and Aditya (ops) to join the architecture review. Lauren from sales ops will help with contracting prerequisites.

Attachments: SOC2 checklist request (we'll need the document + an internal PO contact if procurement will handle the agreement).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@mediscape.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian O'Connor <brian.oconnor@mediscape.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Securing time for on-prem architecture review and next steps

Markus — thanks, this is helpful.

We can do Tue Jul 27 at 09:00 PT (that works for our infra folks). Please book for 60 minutes; I'll invite our security lead, Priya Malhotra, and our on-prem platform engineer, Daniel Cho.

Couple of asks from our side before the call:
- Can you share the Redwood private-deploy checklist and any sample runbook so our team can pre-read?
- Attaching our SOC2_Request.docx which lists the artifacts we need from vendors (control mapping + evidence). Please mark any items you plan to provide during or after the architecture review.
- For the deeper network discussion, we need to confirm whether a cross-connect or VPN approach is recommended given our current colo.

I'll attach the SOC2_Request.docx (attached).

Thanks — Alice

Attachments: SOC2_Request.docx

Subject: Re: Securing time for on-prem architecture review and next steps

Alice — perfect, thanks for confirming. I’ve penciled in Tue Jul 27 09:00 PT on our side and will send a formal calendar invite for Jul 27 09:00–10:00 PT (invite attached).

Per your asks, attaching the Redwood-priv-deploy-checklist.pdf and a short ops checklist that we will walk through during the call. Highlights we'll cover:
- Network options: cross-connect vs. IPsec VPN (pros/cons, bandwidth considerations)
- KMS & key rotation: how we integrate with customer KMS (HSM/KMS patterns)
- Audit logging and retention options (we'll map to SOC 2 controls)
- Rollback and failover strategy for degraded capacity

Action items assigned:
- Markus: send checklist + calendar invite (done)
- Marissa: prepare brief demo slides (10–15 mins) showing control plane + telemetry
- Aditya: prepare runbook excerpts and ops contact list
- Alice: share any topology diagrams you have ahead of the call and the procurement PO contact if available

Attachments: Redwood-priv-deploy-checklist.pdf, redwood-onprem-ops-invite.ics

Thanks — see you on the call.

—
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
